title: OneRanker: Unified Generation and Ranking with One Model in Industrial Advertising Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2603.02999v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The end-to-end generative paradigm is revolutionizing advertising recommendation systems, driving a shift from traditional cascaded architectures towards unified modeling. However, practical deployment faces three core challenges: the misalignment between interest objectives and business value, the target-agnostic limitation of generative processes, and the disconnection between generation and ranking stages. Existing solutions often fall into a dilemma where single-stage fusion induces optimization tension, while stage decoupling causes irreversible information loss. To address this, we propose OneRanker, achieving architectural-level deep integration of generation and ranking. First, we design a value-aware multi-task decoupling architecture. translated_title: OneRanker：工业广告推荐中基于单一模型的统一生成与排序
translated_abstract: 端到端生成式范式正在彻底变革广告推荐系统，推动传统级联架构向统一建模转变。然而，实际部署面临三大核心挑战：兴趣目标与商业价值之间的错位、生成过程的目标无关性局限，以及生成阶段与排序阶段之间的割裂。现有解决方案往往陷入两难困境：单阶段融合会引发优化上的张力冲突，而阶段解耦则会造成不可逆的信息损失。为此，我们提出 OneRanker，实现了生成与排序在架构层面的深度融合。首先，我们设计了价值感知的多任务解耦架构，通过利用任务 token 序列和因果掩码，在共享表示中分离兴趣覆盖与价值优化空间，有效缓解了目标冲突。其次，（摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 提出统一模型 OneRanker，通过价值感知的多任务解耦架构在工业广告推荐中实现生成与排序的架构级深度融合，解决了兴趣与商业价值错位、生成目标无关以及两阶段割裂等核心挑战。
en_tdlr: OneRanker unifies generation and ranking within a single model for industrial advertising recommendation, employing a value-aware multi-task decoupling architecture to address interest-value misalignment, target-agnostic generation, and the disconnection between generation and ranking stages.
